label: Object
description: One significant object: what it is and looks like, who holds it, where it came from, why it matters and how it moves through the story. Places are settings, and the general laws of any magic or technology it uses are world rules.

fields.label: Physical description
fields.help: What the object looks and feels like in the hand: its size, shape, material, colour, condition and any marks that identify it.

fields.label: Kind of object
fields.help: The broad category the object belongs to, which shapes how characters handle it and what a reader assumes it can do.

fields.label: Holder at the opening
fields.help: Who has the object when the story opens, or where it lies if no one holds it, and by what right or means they keep it.

fields.label: Origin
fields.help: Where the object came from, who made or found it, and how it reached the hands or place it occupies when the story opens.

fields.label: Significance
fields.help: Why the object matters to the story's events or to someone in it, and what would change if it had never existed.

fields.label: What it can do
fields.help: What the object lets its holder do or stops them doing, with the general laws of any magic or technology behind it kept as world rules.

fields.label: How it can be lost or ruined
fields.help: The ways the object can be damaged, used up, stolen, mislaid or destroyed, one per item.

fields.label: Worth to the wider world
fields.help: How much people with no personal tie to the object would value it in the story's world, apart from what it means to its holder.

fields.label: Who wants it
fields.help: Each person or group who wants the object, and what they would do with it once they had it, one per item.

fields.label: What is hidden about it
fields.help: Any truth about the object's nature, origin or whereabouts that some characters do not know, who does know it, and when the reader learns it.

fields.label: Changes of hands
fields.help: Each time the object passes from one holder to another during the story, in order, saying from whom to whom and by what means.

fields.label: First appearance on the page
fields.help: Where in the book the reader first meets the object, and how much of its importance shows at that moment.

fields.label: Where it ends up
fields.help: Where the object is, who holds it and what condition it is in when the book ends, or how it ceased to exist.
